name: 网页搜索 / 正文读取
author: flycat666
description: 给模型追加 web_search / web_read / web_search_multi 三个工具。v2 默认走纯 HTTP 引擎链（360 → 必应 → 搜狗 → 百度 → DuckDuckGo），带相关性闸门和跳转链还原，单次 0.3-1.5s；整条链都失败才懒启动无头浏览器兜底。正文读取同样是 HTTP 优先（trafilatura），只有 JS 页 / 403 才开浏览器。插件自包含，不再依赖外部 web_search 项目。
requires: Python 3.10+。纯 HTTP 路径无第三方依赖；浏览器兜底要 playwright + chromium（缺了自动跳过）；正文抽取可选装 trafilatura。

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and get JSON back: position/title/link/snippet/source, plus 'relevance' (0-1) and a 'degraded' flag. Default path is plain HTTP over an engine chain (360 -> cn.bing -> sogou -> baidu -> DuckDuckGo) at ~0.3-1.5s per call; a headless browser only kicks in if the whole chain fails, and it resolves wrapped redirect links into real URLs. Leave the parameters alone for a normal search — the chain already falls back. If 'degraded' is true (or relevance < 0.5, or there is a 'warning'), those results are junk from an anti-bot decoy or a flaky index: re-search with different wording or another engine/chain and never quote them as an answer. After searching, open the most promising link with web_read instead of trusting the snippet.

query.description: What to search for. Keep it short — it is typed into a search box, not into a prompt.

max.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

chain.description: Comma separated HTTP engine chain to try in order, default 'so360,bing-cn,sogou,baidu,ddg'. Use it when one engine is rate-limiting you, e.g. 'so360,sogou' for Chinese content.

engine.description: Pin a single engine and skip the fallback chain (google goes through the headless browser and is slower). Omit it to let the chain decide — that is the recommended default.

domain.description: Keep only results whose link contains this domain, e.g. 'docs.python.org'. The chain keeps trying until some engine has a result on that domain. Useful for official docs; don't write 'site:' in the query.

gate.description: Relevance gate: fraction of results that must actually contain the query words, otherwise the engine counts as degraded and we move on. Default 0.5. Raise it (0.7-0.9) for exact-name / error-string lookups.

mode.description: auto = HTTP chain then browser fallback (default); fast = HTTP only, never start a browser; browser = go straight to the browser engines.

deadline_s.description: Whole-call time budget in seconds (default 25). The chain stops and returns what it has when the budget is spent.

proxy.description: auto = detect (env vars, Windows system proxy, common local ports 7897/7890/10809/1080) — the default; off = force direct connection; or an explicit 'http://127.0.0.1:7890'.

headless.description: Only affects the browser fallback. Default true — leave it alone unless you are watching the screen.

debug.description: Include the resolved chain, gate, proxy and the request URL in the output (for diagnosing a bad engine).

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Open one URL and return its main article text as markdown (navigation, ads and sidebars stripped). HTTP fetch + trafilatura first (~0.7s); a headless browser is used only when the page is JS-rendered or answers 403/412, so a blocked page fails in about 10s instead of hanging. Output is the text followed by one HTML comment line 'url | title | N chars | backend | ms' — if it carries a WARNING or only a few dozen chars, the page is behind a login/anti-bot wall: try another source instead of reporting an empty page. Long pages are cut at max_chars; the host also truncates tool output over 32KB (Chinese is ~3 bytes per char, so keep it under ~10000).

format.description: markdown keeps headings/links/code blocks (default); text is plain and slightly cheaper.

max_chars.description: Truncate the extracted text to this many characters (default 8000). Raise it only when the output says the page was truncated.

wait_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting — only useful with the browser (SPA pages), e.g. 'article' or '.markdown-body'.

scroll.description: Scroll to the bottom first to trigger lazy-loaded content (browser path only, default false).

mode.description: auto = fall back to the browser when HTTP gets nothing (default); fast = HTTP only, fail fast.

json.description: Return a JSON envelope (url/title/chars/backend/text) instead of markdown + comment line. Default false.

tools.name: web_search_multi
tools.description: Search several keywords in one process (default HTTP chain, ~1-2s per keyword) — prefer this over calling web_search N times when you have a fixed list of things to check, since the engine chain, proxy detection and a possible browser are all set up once.

queries.description: Keywords to search, one per entry (max 8).

chain.description: Engine chain for all queries, default 'so360,bing-cn,sogou,baidu,ddg'.

engine.description: Pin one engine for all queries instead of using the chain.

gap_ms.description: Pause between keywords in milliseconds (default 1200). Raise it if the engine starts rate-limiting you.
